d:
Ranchi men lok aastha ke mahaparv chhath se pahle ghaton par jagah gherne ki hor shuru ho gayi hai. nagar nigam ki rok ke bavjud kanke daim, jumar nadi, bara talab aur dusre ghaton par log nam likhkar jagah aarakshit kar rahe hain. kahin ghaton par kachre ka anbar hai, to kahin bans-balli lagakar jagah gheri ja rahi hai.
Vahin, hatniya talab men chhath ki taiyariyan lagbhag puri kar li gayi hain. vratiyon ki suraksha ke lie NDRF, CCTV aur dron kaimron ki vyavastha ki gayi hai.
